description: Periodic conventional diamond-Si cell expanded 3x3x3, with one Li interstitial and two explicitly mapped adjacent tetrahedral endpoints.
endpoint_definition: Initial and final are the two listed Li fractional coordinates in the 3x3x3 conventional-cell supercell; keep all Si atoms mapped identically and use periodic minimum-image displacement.
multiplicity_instruction: Use the lowest physically defensible spin state for neutral and the one-electron-added state; report it explicitly.
units: angstrom for lattice; fractional coordinates for positions; energies in eV
